_schema.description: Suggested line-up for the new site. A frame is one of two shapes plus a background with fully custom text (see product-options.json), so Etsy listings are grouped into search-intent PAGES, not designs. Each page is a preset on the one configurable product. Every Etsy listing appears exactly once. A RECOMMENDATION for the owner to rule on in decisions.json. Nothing here is acted upon automatically. Produced by scripts/lineup-draft.mjs.
_schema.ranking: Pages are ranked by the summed num_favorers of their listings. Lifetime PROXIES for demand: real per-listing sales need Etsy OAuth (transactions_r), which this export does not use.
_schema.tiers: launch = pages that together hold the first 80% of all favourites; later = the next 15%; fold-in = the last 5%, better merged into a broader page.
_schema.intent: recipient and occasion are the earliest matching terms in the Etsy title (keyword rules in scripts/lineup-draft.mjs). productType is frame unless the section or price says brag-board, large-frame, car-accessory or add-on.
